meaning: Section 0 holds the 224 type names then, at 0x14E0, a 176-word table of small values (0x0c, 0, 0, 0xA4, 0x2A8, 0x18, per-type instance sizes/vtable hints, high 90% agreement is not reached so sizes stay a hint, not authoritative) followed by ~75 000 words of 32-bit hashes (name/resource ids, not sizes). It is NOT a sequential record-size stream: cumulative sums from any start index land on almost no record headers, and its sum (12 146) is nothing like the object area (4 234 076). Section 0 is copied to MEM1 (0x814DA800) essentially unchanged at load (2 words of 76 384 differ): it is a lookup table read in place, not walked to build objects. Object sizes are therefore bounded only by the next header (igz.section1.object-list), which is why the loader must already know where records are before constructing them.
structure: Type-name table in blocks with 12-byte block records, then a u32 table
